title: HSK 3.7 · 专业, 职业, 不仅, 实验, 试验
focus: 仅 · 挂 · 专家 · 跳 · 久 · 警察 · 专业 · 牛 · 状态 · 群 · 环境 · 火 · 建立 · 更加 · 必要 · 不断 · 观众 · 真实 · 职业 · 事业 · 状况 · 时代 · 要是 · 年代 · 代 · 不仅 · 事故 · 事实上 · 不得不 · 建 · 时刻 · 断 · 观察 · 立刻 · 实验 · 不必 · 上去 · 仅仅 · 商业 · 试验
body:
Work and time: 业 (line of work) appears in four words, 代 (generation) in three, and 不 starts four words (不断, 不仅, 不得不, 不必). Two near-homophones, 实验 and 试验, sit side by side.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 业 | yè | line of work, trade | 专业, 职业, 事业, 商业 |
| 不 | bù | not | 不断, 不仅, 不得不, 不必 |
| 事 | shì | matter, affair | 事业, 事故, 事实上 |
| 代 | dài | generation; substitute | 时代, 年代, 代 |
| 仅 | jǐn | only | 仅, 不仅, 仅仅 |
| 验 | yàn | test, check (马 + 佥 sound) | 实验, 试验 |
| 状 | zhuàng | form, state | 状态, 状况 |
| 观 | guān | look, watch | 观众, 观察 |

## Watch out

- 实验 shíyàn (experiment: 实 real) vs 试验 shìyàn (trial: 试 try).
- 事故 (accident) vs 故事 (story): same two characters, reversed.
- 牛 niú (ox: the vertical pokes through the top) vs 午 wǔ (noon).

cards.Example: 仅此一次。 jǐn cǐ yí cì: just this once
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 又 (simplified from 僅). Mostly in 不仅 not only and 仅仅 merely.

cards.Example: 先别挂电话。 xiān bié guà diànhuà: don't hang up yet
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 圭 guī for the sound = hang up.

cards.Example: 他是电脑专家。 tā shì diànnǎo zhuānjiā: he's a computer expert
cards.Notes: 专 focused, special + 家 (person of a field, as in 作家 writer) = specialist.

cards.Example: 他跳得很高。 tā tiào de hěn gāo: he jumps really high
cards.Notes: 𧾷 foot + 兆 zhào for the sound = jump. 跳舞 to dance.

cards.Example: 好久不见！ hǎojiǔ bú jiàn: long time no see!
cards.Notes: Just 3 strokes. Same sound as 九 and 酒 jiǔ. Lookalike: 欠 qiàn.

cards.Example: 快叫警察！ kuài jiào jǐngchá: call the police!
cards.Notes: 警 alert, warn (言 speech + 敬 jìng for the sound) + 察 inspect = police.

cards.Example: 你的专业是什么？ nǐ de zhuānyè shì shénme: what's your major?
cards.Notes: 专 specialised + 业 line of work or study = specialty, major; also "professional".

cards.Example: 你真牛！ nǐ zhēn niú: you're amazing!
cards.Notes: Pictograph of an ox's head with horns. Lookalike: 午 wǔ noon, with no stroke poking out the top.

cards.Example: 他今天状态很好。 tā jīntiān zhuàngtài hěn hǎo: he's in good form today
cards.Notes: 状 form, state (丬 + 犬 dog) + 态 attitude (太 + 心) = state, form.

cards.Example: 你在微信群里吗？ nǐ zài Wēixìn qún lǐ ma: are you in the WeChat group?
cards.Notes: 君 jūn for the sound + 羊 sheep = flock of sheep → group.

cards.Example: 这里环境很好。 zhèlǐ huánjìng hěn hǎo: it's a nice place here
cards.Notes: 环 ring, surround (王 jade) + 境 area (土 + 竟 jìng for the sound) = surroundings.

cards.Example: 这首歌很火。 zhè shǒu gē hěn huǒ: this song is really popular
cards.Notes: Pictograph of flames. As a part: 火 on the left or 灬 at the bottom (热, 点, 照).

cards.Example: 他们建立了一家公司。 tāmen jiànlì le yì jiā gōngsī: they set up a company
cards.Notes: 建 build + 立 stand up = set up, establish.

cards.Example: 他更加努力了。 tā gèngjiā nǔlì le: he's working even harder
cards.Notes: 更 gèng more + 加 add = add more → even more. 更 is gēng in 更新.

cards.Example: 没有必要。 méiyǒu bìyào: there's no need
cards.Notes: 必 must + 要 need = necessary. Lookalike: 心 xīn heart vs 必 bì.

cards.Example: 他不断进步。 tā búduàn jìnbù: he keeps improving
cards.Notes: 不 not + 断 break = without a break → continuously.

cards.Example: 观众很多。 guānzhòng hěn duō: there's a big audience
cards.Notes: 观 watch + 众 crowd (three 人) = the watching crowd → audience.

cards.Example: 这是真实的故事。 zhè shì zhēnshí de gùshi: this is a true story
cards.Notes: 真 true + 实 real = genuine.

cards.Example: 你的职业是什么？ nǐ de zhíyè shì shénme: what's your occupation?
cards.Notes: 职 post, duty (耳 + 只) + 业 line of work = occupation.

cards.Example: 他的事业很成功。 tā de shìyè hěn chénggōng: his career is very successful
cards.Notes: 事 work, matter + 业 enterprise = one's life's work → career.

cards.Example: 他的身体状况不好。 tā de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng bù hǎo: his health isn't good
cards.Notes: 状 state + 况 condition = condition. Like 情况, but for health, money, etc.

cards.Example: 时代变了。 shídài biàn le: times have changed
cards.Notes: 时 time + 代 generation = era.

cards.Example: 要是下雨，我就不去。 yàoshi xià yǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù: if it rains, I won't go
cards.Notes: 要 will + 是 be = if it is → if. A spoken 如果.

cards.Example: 我喜欢八十年代的歌。 wǒ xǐhuan bāshí niándài de gē: I like '80s songs
cards.Notes: 年 year + 代 period = a period of years; 八十年代 = the 1980s.

cards.Example: 我代他去。 wǒ dài tā qù: I'll go in his place
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 弋 yì for the sound = a person standing in → substitute. Lookalike: 伐 fá.

cards.Example: 他不仅聪明，还很努力。 tā bùjǐn cōngming, hái hěn nǔlì: he's not only smart but hardworking
cards.Notes: 不 not + 仅 only = not only. Paired with 而且/还/也.

cards.Example: 路上有事故。 lù shang yǒu shìgù: there's an accident on the road
cards.Notes: 事 matter + 故 mishap, cause = accident. Reversed, 故事 gùshi = story.

cards.Example: 事实上他不知道。 shìshíshàng tā bù zhīdào: in fact, he didn't know
cards.Notes: 事实 fact (事 matter + 实 real) + 上 on = on the side of fact → in fact.

cards.Meaning: to have no choice but to
cards.Example: 我不得不走了。 wǒ bùdébù zǒu le: I have to go now
cards.Notes: 不 not + 得 able + 不 not = can't not → have to.

cards.Example: 这里在建新楼。 zhèlǐ zài jiàn xīn lóu: they're building a new block here
cards.Notes: 廴 stride + 聿 brush = build, set up. Written with 聿 first and 廴 last.

cards.Example: 时刻注意安全。 shíkè zhùyì ānquán: always stay alert to safety
cards.Notes: 时 time + 刻 quarter hour, carve = a moment; as an adverb, "at every moment".

cards.Example: 电话断了。 diànhuà duàn le: the call dropped
cards.Notes: Left part (米 in a frame) + 斤 axe = cut off. 不断 nonstop.

cards.Example: 他在观察鸟。 tā zài guānchá niǎo: he's watching birds
cards.Notes: 观 look + 察 examine (宀 roof + 祭) = observe closely.

cards.Example: 我立刻来。 wǒ lìkè lái: I'll come right away
cards.Notes: 立 stand + 刻 moment = this very moment → immediately.

cards.Example: 我们做个实验。 wǒmen zuò ge shíyàn: let's do an experiment
cards.Notes: 实 real + 验 test = a real test → experiment. Compare 试验 trial.

cards.Example: 你不必来。 nǐ búbì lái: you don't need to come
cards.Notes: 不 not + 必 must = not necessary.

cards.Example: 我们上去看看。 wǒmen shàngqu kànkan: let's go up and look
cards.Notes: 上 up + 去 go (away from the speaker) = go up.

cards.Example: 我仅仅睡了三个小时。 wǒ jǐnjǐn shuì le sān ge xiǎoshí: I only slept three hours
cards.Notes: 仅 only, doubled = merely, just.

cards.Example: 这是商业区。 zhè shì shāngyè qū: this is the business district
cards.Notes: 商 trade + 业 industry = commerce.

cards.Example: 新药在试验中。 xīn yào zài shìyàn zhōng: the new drug is being tested
cards.Notes: 试 try + 验 check = trial. Same sound as 实验 (experiment, 实 real).
